title: Professor(a) de Português (Produção Textual) - Fundamental 2 - Barra da Tijuca/RJ
description:
O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de 121 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes e que utilizam as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de qualidade máxima para mais de 95.000 alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio.

Nossas escolas Inspired estão em 27 países e cada uma é pensada individualmente de acordo com o contexto local e é ancorada na cultura vibrante na qual se encontra. Coletivamente, elas compõem uma comunidade que nutre o desenvolvimento acadêmico e pessoal dos alunos num ambiente de aprendizagem progressivo, dinâmico e inovador.

Se juntando ao nosso time de mais de 13.000 colaboradores, você poderá trabalhar em instalações de última geração ao lado de educadores e líderes renomados do setor em alguns dos lugares mais desejados do mundo. Investimos fortemente nas nossas equipes e assim cada um consegue aproveitar desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira excepcionais e mobilidade em todo o nosso grupo.

SOBRE A VAGA

A Escola Eleva é uma das escolas Inspired no Brasil. Aqui nós temos vocação para ensinar e paixão por aprender. Nosso time é movido por excelência, entusiasmo, respeito e responsabilidade. Somos adeptos da mentalidade de crescimento e estamos constantemente motivados a buscar o que há de melhor em educação, no Brasil e no mundo e em pensar as melhores maneiras de aplicar isso em nossas escolas e inspirar nossos alunos.

Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de líderes capazes de fazer a diferença em suas vidas e contribuir para um mundo melhor. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos e movidos por entusiasmo. Pessoas que superam desafios diariamente, com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.

Procuramos um(a) Professor(a) de Português (Produção Textual) para o Fundamental 2. Deve ser uma pessoa com paixão por educação e pelo universo dinâmico da escola, que tenha experiência em escola regular ou bilíngue com planejamento e execução de aulas dessa disciplina.

RESPONSABILIDADES

O que você fará:

  • Adquirir conhecimento sobre os programas curriculares utilizados nas séries em que leciona;
  • Trabalhar colaborativamente com outros professores e lideranças da matéria e do segmento, buscando alinhamento e consistência;
  • Planejar as aulas e produzir materiais pedagógicos, levando em conta as individualidades dos alunos;
  • Ministrar aulas de Português (Produção Textual) alinhadas com a BNCC e o Material Didático selecionado pela escola (físico ou digital);
  • Utilizar práticas variadas de ensino/aprendizagem, incluindo metodologias ativas, ensino responsivo, avaliação para o aprendizado (Assessment for Learning) e métodos investigativos;
  • Utilizar de forma consistente tecnologias para enriquecer e melhorar o aprendizado;
  • Supervisionar alunos em espaços escolares;
  • Substituir professores no mesmo segmento quando solicitado;
  • Mediar relacionamento entre crianças, famílias e escola;
  • Preparar avaliações e comunicar os resultados;
  • Tabular e analisar dados pedagógicos com o intuito de ajustar ensino e melhorar o aprendizado;
  • Formatar e alimentar com dados nossa plataforma de acompanhamento de avaliações (iSams) em preparação para relatórios para famílias;
  • Participar de reuniões pedagógicas (incluindo COC) e eventos realizados na escola;
  • Garantir a segurança física e emocional dos alunos, e zelar pelo seu crescimento sócio-emocional (safeguarding).

Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. Dessa forma, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se aplicam ao cargo.

REQUISITOS

O que você precisa ter:

  • Diploma de Licenciatura em Letras;
  • Experiência com Fundamental 2.

Nossos professores devem ser capazes de/devem ter:

  • Capacidade de trabalhar colaborativamente, em equipe;
  • Paixão pela profissão;
  • Adaptar seu estilo de ensino incorporando feedbacks;
  • Estar sempre em busca de melhorias;
  • Atitude positiva frente a mudanças;
  • Compreensão profunda da matéria lecionada;
  • Estabelecer expectativas claras e esticar metas;
  • Excelente planejamento de aulas e domínio de sala;
  • Habilidade de julgar a efetividade do aprendizado;
  • Comprometimento com o desenvolvimento dos alunos, avaliando os resultados e fornecendo feedback para melhorar seu desempenho;
  • Preocupação e atenção genuína pelos níveis mais altos de bem-estar dos alunos.

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência em escolas bilíngues ou internacionais;
  • Espírio colaborativo - desejo de trabalhar como parte de um time;
  • Pós-graduação em andamento ou concluída;
  • Inglês.

DECLARAÇÃO DE SALVAGUARDA

O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. A proteção do bem-estar dos nossos alunos é de responsabilidade de todos os colaboradores e os mesmos devem se comportar de maneira a refletir os princípios e valores da organização. Qualquer candidato pode ser submetido aos procedimentos apropriados de verificação.

title: Project Manager
description:
Intermoor, Acteon's Moorings and Anchors business line, provides project and operational management expertise to customers across the mooring lifecycle. By combining operational knowledge of mooring equipment, anchor handling and industry failure modes with subsea engineering expertise, we create a company unmatched within the mooring niche. This approach mitigates risks in delivery, installation and operations across the lifecycle, reducing mooring lifecycle costs and safeguarding major operations that protect start-up schedules when mooring and mooring intervention are on the project or production critical path.

InterMoor is looking to add a Project Manager to the team. The Project Manager's primary responsibility is to plan, direct, and coordinate activities of a single or multiple projects to ensure that goals or objectives of project are safely accomplished within prescribed time frame and funding parameters and the customer receives a quality product or service which meets or exceeds all of the customer requirements.

The successful candidate will be based in the Rio de Janeiro area.

Please submit Resumes/CVs in English.

Duties

  • Plan, direct and coordinate the activities of one or more projects, ensuring that the objectives are achieved safely, within the established deadlines and budget limits
  • Structure and monitor project budgets, providing revenue and cost analysis, including the appropriate credit releases, as well as participate in the revenue and cost forecast process
  • Develop and maintain the project schedule with resource allocation, including detailed work breakdown structure (WBS)
  • Manage projects and assigned teams on a daily basis, including planning operations and supervising operational personnel in the field, reviewing procedures, staffing needs, and resource allocation in all phases of the project, ensuring compliance with schedule and budget
  • Act in the daily monitoring of projects and systems to identify deviations and ensure that activities occur as planned
  • Propose and implement solutions to mitigate operational downtime or delays that impact the customer or the profitability of the project
  • Support customers in the elaboration of design concepts and technical specifications
  • Conduct presentations and support commercial activities
  • When applicable, coordinate with the Operations and Commercial areas the development of proposals and bids
  • Review and approve quality plans and technical procedures, as well as develop procedures for subsea projects, when necessary
  • Analyze proposals and project plans to define deadlines, budget limits, procedures, staffing needs, and resource allocation by phase
  • Define the work plan and the sizing of teams for each phase of the project, informing the personnel needs to the Operations area
  • Align work plans with project teams, assigning responsibilities, scope, and levels of authority
  • Direct and coordinate project activities to ensure execution on time and within the approved budget
  • Review status reports and adjust timelines or plans as needed
  • Oversee the issuance of requisitions that are not related to general maintenance and repairs, as well as review and approve supplier invoices
  • Prepare project reports, forecasts, variance analysis and other technical and financial reports for management, customers or other stakeholders
  • Together with Technical Support, provide support to project teams, offering technical guidance and support in solving problems
  • Review and approve project invoices and support the financial area in matters related to accounts receivable with customers
  • Carry out national and international trips, as needed
  • Maintain mandatory training according to management guidelines
  • Work in close collaboration with the Commercial Department in the analysis of ITTs and submission of proposals, ensuring a well-defined scope, technical skills, necessary equipment and full understanding of terms, conditions and pricing
  • In coordination with the Commercial area, make presentations to customers about new technologies or solutions that improve their performance
  • Implement QHSE Management Systems and ensure compliance with local regulations
  • Verify the compliance of the systems with all Technical, Operational and QHSE bulletins
  • Prepare project reports, forecasts, variance analysis and other technical or financial reports as required by management, customers or other stakeholders

Required

  • Complete higher education in Engineering, preferably Naval Engineering
  • Active CREA registration
  • Desirable post-graduation in a related area
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Desirable good knowledge in Autocad, Office package, AutoCAD®, SolidWorks, Orcaflex
  • Desirable experience of at least 8 years in the design and/or installation of permanent anchoring systems for units such as FPSOs, FSOs, FSUs or CALM buoys, among others
  • Experience in developing offshore operating procedures for subsea installation and/or construction
  • Good vision and business understanding
  • Experience in installing flexible and umbilical risers
  • Expertise in installation analysis
  • Experience using OrcaFlex software

Carta is trusted by more than 40,000 companies and over two million people in nearly 160 countries to manage cap tables, compensation, and valuations. Carta also supports nearly 7,000 funds and SPVs, and represents nearly $130B in assets under administration. Carta’s tender offer solutions have returned $14B to shareholders in secondary transactions. Today, Carta’s platform manages nearly three trillion dollars in equity globally.

Problems You’ll Solve

  • Collaborate with new fund clients to collect data and advise on best accounting practices within Service Level Agreements (SLAs)
  • Effectively liaise between sales and Fund Accounting teams as the bridge post‑sales
  • Identify process and quality improvements and highlight them to appropriate leadership
  • Create balanced, accurate quarterly financial statements from, at times, unstructured client data

The Team You'll Work With

As an Implementations Accountant, you will join a team that supports new Fund Administration customers in their journey into Carta services. You will drive operational excellence within our fast‑growing Fund Administration business by coordinating, facilitating, and managing onboarding activities that are critical to achieving success for both our customers and Carta within a tight deadline.

In this role you will be responsible for interacting with a fund’s back office (CFO fund manager) to collect their historical data, provide advisory support, and ultimately deliver accurate financial statements to both the client and internal stakeholders.

From sale close, to implementation, and continued customer success, the ideal Implementations Accountant will exhibit a high degree of problem‑solving, efficiency, and integrity as they leverage their subject‑matter expertise to provide customers with a world‑class onboarding experience.

About You

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field, or equivalent experience
  • 1+ years of experience in a role with a finance or accounting background
  • Strong accounting analysis with the ability to interpret a story through unstructured data
  • Committed to team and project success, emotionally intelligent in navigating relationships, transparent and forthright when communicating information, and passionate about growing and advancing with Carta
  • Proven internal influencer having implemented and successfully managed both small and large projects or initiatives with sustained, measurable success
  • Incredible organizational skills, high attention to detail, and an ability to complete competing priorities quickly and autonomously
  • Ability to communicate in both written and verbal formats in a timely and appropriate manner
  • Fluent in English, both written and verbal

Nice‑to‑Haves

  • Acumen in or knowledge of accounting with a specific focus in venture, hedge fund, and/or private equity
  • Familiarity as an end user with Carta or other financial dataset or accounting software programs

Compensation

Carta’s compensation package includes a market competitive salary, equity for all full time roles, exceptional benefits, and, for applicable roles, commissions plans. Our expected cash compensation range for this role is:

  • $81,000 - $85,000 in New York, New York
  • $81,000 - $85,000 in San Francisco, California
  • $72,900 - $76,500 in Seattle, Washington

description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The West Campus Facilities Manager provides senior-level leadership and operational management for all facilities, maintenance, custodial coordination, and infrastructure operations across Howard University’s West Campus. This position serves as the primary facilities authority for the campus, ensuring that buildings, utilities, and grounds remain safe, reliable, and fully operational. The Manager oversees maintenance teams, custodial partners, and contractors while ensuring full compliance with engineering standards, APPA benchmarks, regulatory requirements, and University service expectations. The role carries significant operational responsibility and autonomy due to the size, complexity, and visibility of West Campus.

Supervisory Authority

Supervises maintenance technicians, trades personnel, custodial leads, administrative support, and contracted service providers assigned to West Campus. Oversees external vendors performing preventive maintenance, building repairs, custodial operations, inspections, and other facilities-related services.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include faculty, staff, students, Residence Life, Public Safety, academic departments, and administrative units. External contacts include contractors, vendors, utility partners, regulatory inspectors, custodial firms, and maintenance service providers. The Manager serves as the face of PFM for all West Campus facilities matters.

Principal Accountabilities

Campus Operations & Building Systems Oversight

  • Leads daily facilities operations for West Campus to ensure uninterrupted, high-quality building performance.
  • Manages preventive, corrective, and predictive maintenance across HVAC, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and life-safety systems.
  • Conducts regular facility inspections to identify deficiencies, risks, code issues, and asset renewal needs.
  • Ensures timely work order management, documentation accuracy, and performance tracking through the CMMS.
  • Ensures coordination with capital projects and handoff from construction to operations.

Custodial Management & Service Quality

  • Coordinates custodial scheduling, assignments, and service quality aligned with APPA Level 2 standards.
  • Evaluates custodial contractor performance and directs corrective actions when service gaps arise.

Vendor, Contract, and Compliance Oversight

  • Oversees on-site performance of vendors supporting maintenance, custodial, utilities, and technical service operations.
  • Ensures full compliance with OSHA, EPA, NFPA, fire/life safety codes, and environmental health requirements.
  • Supports audits, inspections, and regulatory documentation.

Asset Management & Preventive Maintenance

  • Implements preventive maintenance programs to optimize asset life, system reliability, and operational efficiency.
  • Works closely with the Deputy Director and QA/QC Manager on engineering standards and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Recommends capital renewal and lifecycle replacement priorities for campus infrastructure.

Stakeholder Relations & Customer Service

  • Acts as the primary point of contact for West Campus stakeholders.
  • Communicates maintenance activities, project impacts, and operational issues clearly and professionally.
  • Supports high-demand operational needs such as special events, move-ins/outs, and seasonal transitions.

Emergency Response & Safety Leadership

  • Leads operational response during outages, building emergencies, and severe weather events.
  • Ensures appropriate use of PPE, safe work practices, and hazard mitigation strategies.
  • Supports continuity-of-operations planning for critical campus systems.

Other Duties

  • Provides input on staffing needs, training, workflows, and operational efficiencies.
  • Supports deferred maintenance efforts and campus improvement initiatives.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

Core Competencies

  • Expert knowledge of building operations, maintenance, and custodial service standards.
  • Strong leadership and team management skills.
  • Excellent communication and customer service skills.
  • Solid problem-solving and analytical capabilities.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Commitment to operational excellence, safety, and continuous improvement.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s degree preferred; associate degree with extensive experience considered. At least 7 years of progressive experience in facilities operations, building maintenance, or engineering services. Supervisory experience overseeing teams or contractors. Strong technical knowledge of HVAC, electrical, plumbing, and building systems. Proficiency with CMMS systems and work order management. OSHA, CEFP, or trade certifications preferred. Ability to respond to emergencies, work evenings/weekends, and support critical campus needs.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure
$110,000 - $115,000

title: Lead Life Cycle Engineer/ Expert/  Specialist
description:
Overview

At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry. You’ll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don’t just move the world forward—we’re proud to be recognized as a Great Place to Work® by our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.

Are you ready to love your job? The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.

About The Role & Team

Lead Life Cycle Engineer is Responsible for service provisioning and the end-to-end lifecycle of network security, shared infrastructure, SD-WAN, and other cloud security solutions.

What You Will Do

  • Manage the end-to-end lifecycle of network services (LAN wired/wireless, WAN, SD-WAN, network security, and shared infrastructure) from provisioning to decommissioning at airports and gateways.
  • Lead implementation and deployment of airport network and security infrastructure, including LAN, WAN, firewalls, and Versa SD-WAN solutions.
  • Provide expert-level support for complex network and security incidents when required.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including GEOs, to validate design documents, implement, and optimize network services aligned with business and customer needs.
  • Oversee service provisioning to ensure timely, accurate delivery and adherence to quality and operational standards.
  • Non-intrusive resiliency testing, timely audit security and configuration parameters aligned with engineering guidelines, drive proactive continuous service improvements.
  • Manage changes and enhancements to network and security services, mitigating risks and minimizing operational disruption.
  • Drive migration management activities, including root cause analysis and service improvement initiatives.
  • Evaluate and adopt new technologies, provide guidance and training to operational teams, and support 24/7 operations and on-call activities as required.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Network Engineering, or a related field.
  • Mandatory Security Associate–level certification and Professional-level SD-WAN certification.
  • Relevant industry certifications such as CCNP, CompTIA Network+, or equivalent are highly desirable.
  • 8–10 years of proven experience managing the end-to-end lifecycle of network services, including provisioning, monitoring, optimization, and decommissioning.
  • Strong knowledge of network service lifecycle management, service models, SLAs, and network management tools.
  • Hands-on experience in network service design, implementation, troubleshooting, and performance optimization.
  • Solid understanding of incident, problem, and change management processes within network operations.
  • Strong working knowledge of routing protocols (BGP, OSPF; EIGRP and RIP as a plus).
  • Strong working knowledge of network and security technologies, including VTP, STP/RSTP/PVST, HSRP, and firewalls (Cisco ASA, Palo Alto).
  • Experience with Cisco and Juniper routers and switches, data center technologies (Cisco Nexus, ACI), and SD-WAN solutions (Versa preferred), with the ability to collaborate cross-functionally and support operational teams.

What We Offer

We’re all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We’re really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too.

Flex Week: Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on your team’s needs)

Flex Day: Make your workday suit your life and plans.

Flex-Location: Take up to 30 days a year to work from any location in the world.

Employee Wellbeing: We have got you covered with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), for you and your dependents 24/7, 365 days/year. We also offer Champion Health - a personalized platform that supports a range of wellbeing needs.

Professional Development: Level up your skills with our training platforms, including LinkedIn Learning!

Competitive Benefits: Competitive benefits that make sense with both your local market and employment status.

SITA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value a diverse workforce. In support of our Employment Equity Program, we encourage women, aboriginal people, members of visible minorities, and/or persons with disabilities to apply and self-identify in the application process.

description:
Overview

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Benefits

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

Conduct NIH-funded research on RNA-based gene regulation in Staphylococcus aureus, a gram-positive bacterial pathogen prone to cause multi-drug-resistant bloodstream infections. The specific focus will be on small proteins, small RNAs, and tRNA modifications. The postdoctoral research fellow will lead experiments investigating RNA–RNA and RNA–protein interactions in bacterial stress adaptation and virulence.

Supervisory Authority

Dr. Karl M. Thompson, Ph.D. – Associate Professor and University Biosafety Officer

Nature And Scope

This is a lab-based research position in molecular microbiology. The Fellow will:

  • Perform functional studies of small protein and RNA function and interactions using and combination of molecular genetics (mutants, over-expression, gene-fusions, two-hybrid constructs); biochemical and biophysical tools (e.g., AUC, MST, SEC-MALS).
  • Conduct RNA stability assays, RIP-seq, and bacterial genetics.
  • Collaborate on in vivo studies and murine infection models.
  • Contribute to mentoring, manuscript writing, and data presentation.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Design and execute experiments on RNA regulators and stress-response pathways.
  • Analyze and interpret data from RNA-protein and RNA-RNA interaction assays.
  • Generate and characterize mutant bacterial strains.
  • Maintain detailed lab records and uphold research rigor.
  • Support manuscript and grant preparation.

Core Competencies

  • Strong background in molecular microbiology and RNA biology.

title: Service Engineer
description:
MacGregor is a global company that operates in 30 countries with 2000 employees. We provide sustainable cargo and load handling with a strong portfolio of products, services, and solutions to the maritime and offshore industries. Our solutions are found in over half of the world's merchant fleet.

We believe MacGregor is a great place to work and we are looking for innovators with an international mindset to join our team and help us create lifetime value for our customers.

MacGregor – Let's shape the future together

Are you driven by problem solving? Do you thrive working with complex and large equipment? Look no further, MacGregor is looking to hire a Service Engineer with strong Mechanical and Hydraulic competence. Knowledge of software and automation systems is a significant plus.

The purpose of this role is to execute service, repair and maintenance work, such as diagnostics, troubleshooting, repair of advanced hydraulic and mechanical equipment on the MacGregor product range, mostly cranes and winches.

We are looking for a candidate with previous experience within the offshore, ship, or rig equipment sector working with products such as winches, cranes and steering gears, but not limited to. Your main discipline is mechanical and hydraulic, in addition you have basic knowledge of electrical or/and automation components. As a person you are customer-oriented, cooperative, and have excellent communication skills, with the ability to effectively share information within the team.

This is a position that requires that you travel to client sites, vessels or at shipyards worldwide. Our clients are primarily domestic but also spread across the globe, i.e. Europe, the US, China, Australia, Singapore, and beyond. Therefore, flexibility and a strong willingness to travel is essential. Our office and workshop is located in the Rio de Janeiro area where you might be assigned to local work if needed, therefore it is essential that you live within reach.

More tasks and responsibilities

  • Diagnostics and troubleshooting of mechanical and hydraulic systems
  • Advanced maintenance on hydraulic and mechanical, basic electrical and automation and maintenance of equipment

  • Stay up to date with relevant developments, routines, processes and news
  • Provide information and write reports as required
  • Support sales activities such as follow-up on leads and quotes while at site, as agreed with sales responsible
  • Follow all site safety rules, agreed working practices and environmental requirements
  • Comply with all relevant safety and quality requirements according to MacGregor. Reporting directly to the Operations Superintendent. The position will be based in MacGregor’s office in Rio de Janeiro, (Niterói / São Gonçalo).

What you’ll need to succeed

  • Technical education at Bachelors or Technical College level within Mechanical or Hydraulic. Relevant experience may compensate for lack of education
  • Minimum 7 years of experience from similar position
  • Experience with hydraulic and mechanical drawings
  • Previous experience with winches, cranes, steering gear is a must
  • Basic knowledge in both automation and/or electrical fields is a valuable asset
  • Proven experience working with computer systems professionally
  • Good English language - both verbal and written

Why MacGregor?

Our people are behind every success. People create the technology and product lifecycle solutions that make us great, our people are the ones who innovate, and people drive our business forward. With us you will be part of an international collaborative working culture with challenges and opportunities to further develop yourself professionally. We enable sustainable global maritime operations by maximizing efficiency in cargo and load handling.

  • Integrity steers all our thinking, behaviour and the relationships with our customers and other stakeholders
  • Quality is valued in our processes, products and services and helps to improve our customers’ performance and our own competences
  • Safety is essential in everything we do

MacGregor is an equal opportunity employer. We recognise that diversity is key to our continued success, and strive to maintain a fair and equitable recruitment process for all applicants.

Additional information

Do you have questions regarding the role? Please contact Vinicius Lima, Operations Superintendent at

Kindly note that we will only review CVs and applications submitted in English through our recruitment portal. Unfortunately we do not consider CVs sent via email.

If you are ready to step into an exciting new role where you can make a significant impact and contribute to the success of MacGregor, apply today!

QA/QC.**What you’ll do*** Provide conceptual input and technical leadership in architecture and design discussions across ML, cloud, and geospatial workflows.* Translate business needs into technical efficiency and operational readiness of selected product components (reliability, scalability, performance, maintainability).* Assure successful deployment of product/service/technology, including troubleshooting and resolution of operational issues.* Document and demonstrate solutions with clear technical documentation and diagrams (flowcharts, layouts, architecture, data flows).* Collect, analyze, and summarize development and service issues to improve platform quality and team execution.* Actively drive knowledge exchange by leading design reviews, “known problems/solutions” sessions, and adoption of industry best practices.* Support and develop less experienced engineers through coaching, mentorship, and opportunities for learning.**What you bring (required)*** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Machine Learning, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related engineering field.* 5+ years of professional experience building and maintaining software systems using relevant technologies.* 3+ years of hands-on experience delivering machine learning solutions (including deep learning) to production or production-like environments.* Strong foundations in software engineering and system design (object-oriented design, testing, maintainability, reliability).* Experience with Python and C#, or at least one additional language used in product development.* MLOps experience (model packaging, deployment, monitoring, drift/quality checks, reproducible training).* Ability to lead major aspects of design, development, and maintenance, including advanced troubleshooting of operational systems.* Strong written and verbal English communication skills; comfortable explaining technical tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.**Nice to have*** Geospatial data experience (raster/vector, coordinate systems, tiling) and/or remote sensing workflows.* Experience with microservices architecture and container orchestration.* AWS (Amazon Web Services) cloud application development experience.* Experience with serverless and/or edge computing patterns.**About Fugro Innovation**Fugro’s innovation teams develop solutions for both internal users and Fugro’s clients. With innovation centers in Canada, Brazil, the USA, and other key locations worldwide, you will join a global innovation group with a tradition of building best-of-class applications in the Geo-Data space.Our engineers work across domains such as spatial data, cloud computing, deep learning, and process automation.**Growth opportunity**At Fugro, we help employees at every career stage identify and apply their strengths to do their best work. We support growth through on-the-job learning as well as formal internal and external development programs.International Geo-data environment - We work for and with the entire world. The Earth is fascinating, as are the people on it. We work hard to create and maintain an inclusive culture. Challenging projects and exciting opportunities - We are ahead of the curve and have the best projects to work on. In addition, exciting opportunities arise around the world every day. Freedom to grow faster - If you are prepared to take the initiative, ample opportunities locally or worldwide await you at Fugro.**Disclaimer for recruitment agencies:****Fugro does not accept any unsolicited applications from recruitment agencies. title: Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer to our Information Systems (IS) team. This role is an opportunity for an "automation-first" senior technologist with a passion for Linux to build a career with Canonical and drive the success with those leveraging Ubuntu and open source products. If you have experience of IT operations automation, Infrastructure as Code and a passion for technology, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.

Job Summary

The IS team at Canonical supports and maintains all of Canonical's IT production services. The team is in charge of running services used by over 60 million Ubuntu users.

Responsibilities

  • Drive the development of automation, Gitops in your team as an embedded tech lead
  • Closely collaborate with the IS architect to align your solutions with the IS architecture vision
  • Design and architect services that IS can offer to the organization as products
  • Apply your experience of IaC to develop infrastructure as code practice within IS by constantly increasing automation and improving IaC processes
  • Automate software operations for re-usability and consistency across private and public clouds, taking into consideration the complexities of distributed systems
  • Maintain operational responsibility for all of Canonical's core services, networks, and infrastructure
  • Develop skills in troubleshooting, capacity planning, and performance investigation, setting up, maintaining and using observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and Elasticsearch; design, implement and maintain monitoring and alerting for various systems and services
  • Provide assistance and work with globally distributed engineering, operations, and support peers
  • Be given uninterrupted development time to focus on larger projects and automation of manual tasks
  • Share your experience, know-how and best practices with other team members in design sessions, mentorship and 'doing work together'
  • Carry final responsibility for time-critical escalations

What we are looking for in you

  • A modern view on hosting architecture, driven by infrastructure as code across both private and public clouds.
  • A product mindset thriving to develop products rather than solutions.
  • Python software development experience, with large projects
  • Experience working with Kubernetes or other container orchestration systems.
  • Proven exposure to manage and deploy cloud infrastructure with code.
  • Practical knowledge of Linux networking, routing, and firewalls
  • Affinity with various forms of Linux storage, from Ceph to Databases
  • Hands-on experience administering enterprise Linux servers
  • Extensive knowledge of cloud computing concepts and technologies
  • Bachelor's degree or greater, preferably in computer science or related engineering field
  • Able to communicate clearly and effectively in English over email, chat, video or voice calls and in-person
  • Motivated and able to troubleshoot from kernel to web, and willing to ask others when appropriate

description:
Descrição da vaga

#VemSerMAG

Se você quer trabalhar com propósito, desenvolver sua carreira, mas sem deixar de lado sua saúde e bem-estar, a MAG é o seu lugar! Temos em nosso DNA a inovação e o cuidado com as pessoas. Desde 2016 estamos na lista das melhores empresas para se trabalhar, segundo a Great Place to Work.

Somos uma empresa PLURAL!

Diversidade e inclusão estão na pauta constante da MAG. Nos orgulhamos de ser uma companhia formada por mais de 80% de todos os nossos colaboradores pertencentes a, pelo menos, um grupo minorizado. Contamos também com o Plural, programa formal, estruturado e direcionado ao fomento da diversidade e inclusão.

Nosso propósito e valores

Estamos em busca de pessoas que tenham valores alinhados aos nossos:

Atitude de dono, História de transformação, Relações duradouras e Ser presente.

Na MAG temos o forte propósito de oferecer soluções financeiras nos diversos momentos de vida de todos os brasileiros. Nos últimos três anos, realizamos o pagamento de mais de R$ 1 bilhão em benefícios a milhares de famílias. Dados como esse que nos levam a ser referência no mercado de Vida e Previdência, com quase 200 anos de atuação ininterrupta no Brasil.

Somos parte do Grupo Aegon, um dos maiores grupos de Seguro de Vida e Previdência do mundo. No Brasil, nossa força também impressiona: temos mais de 5,8 milhões de vidas seguradas e crescemos, em média, 16% ao ano na última década.

Quer fazer parte dessa história? Conheça a nossa oportunidade.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Estamos em busca de um Analista de Recursos Humanos Sênior, que irá atuar na análise avançada de dados de pessoas, transformando informações complexas em diagnósticos, previsões e insights estratégicos que apoiem a tomada de decisão da liderança, além de fortalecer a atuação data driven da área de Gente e Gestão, garantindo qualidade analítica, consistência metodológica e visão de curto e longo prazo.

Quais serão os seus principais desafios:

  • Realizar análises estatísticas descritivas, diagnósticas, preditivas e prescritivas sobre dados de pessoas (turnover, headcount, absenteísmo, produtividade, engajamento, movimentações, custos, etc.).
  • Desenvolver modelos analíticos e estudos de correlação/causalidade, identificando padrões, tendências, riscos e oportunidades.
  • Apoiar a definição e evolução de KPIs estratégicos de People Analytics, garantindo coerência conceitual e robustez analítica.
  • Atuar na formulação de hipóteses junto às lideranças e RH, conduzindo análises profundas que suportem decisões de negócio.
  • Traduzir análises complexas em insights claros, acionáveis e executivos, adequados a diferentes públicos.
  • Apoiar tecnicamente a construção e evolução de dashboards, garantindo que a visualização refl corretamente as análises realizadas.
  • Trabalhar de forma integrada com áreas de Remuneração, RH, Engenharia de Dados e BI, conectando necessidades analíticas a dados estruturados.
  • Contribuir para a automação e melhoria dos processos analíticos, reduzindo esforço manual e aumentando a confiabilidade.
  • Garantir boas práticas de uso de dados, respeitando diretrizes de governança, segurança da informação e LGPD.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que esperamos de você:

    \ística, Matemática, Ciência de Dados, Economia, Administração, Engenharia ou área relacionada;
  • Conhecimento em Estatística aplicada (descritiva, inferencial e fundamentos de predição).
  • Análise de dados aplicada a People Analytics.
  • Modelagem e interpretação de indicadores de RH.
  • Ferramentas de BI e visualização de dados.
  • Fundamentos de governança de dados e qualidade da informação.
  • Conhecimentos em linguagens para análise de dados (Python e/ou R).
  • Noções de LGPD aplicadas a dados de pessoas.
  • Proatividade na identificação de oportunidades de melhoria;
  • Visão de longo prazo e foco em impacto no negócio;

title: Estágio em Redes Sociais - Futebol BR
description:
O que nos move?

Claro, a paixão por esportes é indiscutível, mas também somos grandes amantes de inovação constante! Buscamos soluções digitais que conectem clubes, federações, ligas e marcas ao público de forma eficaz e inovadora. Nosso objetivo é construir um ecossistema que sustente o esporte nas próximas décadas, integrando o melhor do digital e da TV. É assim que estamos fazendo história e queremos encontrar mais pessoas que acreditem no potencial do que estamos construindo e queiram fazer parte disso.

Como Estágio de Redes Sociais - Futebol BR

Sua missão será criar e adaptar conteúdos que traduzam o espírito olímpico em formatos digitais com a cara da CazéTV, leves, autênticos, conectados e cheios de personalidade. Você vai fortalecer nossa presença nas redes sociais trazendo ideias, recortes e conversas que aproximem ainda mais o público da nossa comunidade, ajudando a construir conteúdos que conectem esporte, audiência e marca do jeitinho que a gente gosta: verdadeiro, direto e com paixão pelo jogo . Tudo isso impulsionando não apenas nossa atuação no mercado, mas também a forma como o esporte é vivido, sentido e celebrado todos os dias.

Responsabilidades

  • Produção de Conteúdo: Publicar artes e vídeos para redes sociais de notícias dos atletas e das modalidades olímpicas.
  • Edição Ágil: Utilizar ferramentas de edição para criar artes e vídeos para publicação, garantindo eficiência e qualidade no fluxo diário.
  • Cobertura em Tempo Real: acompanhar competições e transmissões da CazéTV (jogos e programas), assegurando agilidade.
  • Monitoramento e Tendências: Observar movimentos das plataformas, identificar formatos emergentes e sugerir ideias que mantenham a LiveMode na vanguarda do conteúdo esportivo.
  • Colaboração Multidisciplinar: Trabalhar junto ao time de transmissões, design e audiovisual para fortalecer aplicações.
  • Apoio Operacional: Auxiliar no calendário de postagem e na promoção de eventos da CazéTV.

Requisitos Necessários

  • Matrícula ativa em curso superior: Base acadêmica que apoia o desenvolvimento técnico e profissional na área.
  • Previsão de formatura entre 12/2026 e 12/2027: Garantindo tempo adequado de evolução dentro do programa de estágio.
  • Disponibilidade para estagiar 30h semanais: Essencial para acompanhar o ritmo dinâmico da área.
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar presencialmente: Importante para integração com o time e ritmo colaborativo.
  • Ser heavy user de redes sociais e apaixonado(a) por esportes, especialmente os olímpicos: Competência fundamental para criar conteúdo relevante e conectado com a comunidade.
  • Noções básicas de edição de imagem e vídeo: Habilidade técnica necessária para atuar com autonomia no fluxo diário de produção.

Diferenciais Desejáveis

  • Experiência prévia criando conteúdo digital: Mesmo em projetos pessoais ou acadêmicos, mostra iniciativa e familiaridade com o formato.
  • Interesse por inovação e novas tecnologias na produção de conteúdo: Agrega valor ao time e abre espaço para experimentação.
  • Inglês intermediário: Facilita acesso a referências, pesquisas e cobertura internacional.

Bolsa auxílio

R$ 1.800,00 por mês.

Nossos Benefícios

  • Auxílio Alimentação de R$ 1.250,00 por mês, para utilização em restaurantes, mercados, aplicativos de comida e estabelecimentos físicos ou online.
  • Vale Transporte (opcional) proporcional à quantidade de deslocamentos utilizados por dia, sem desconto no valor da bolsa.
  • Plano de Saúde (SulAmérica Vital) com cobertura nacional e acomodação em apartamento, incluindo consultas, exames, pronto-socorro, cirurgias, internações hospitalares, partos e outros serviços. Não há coparticipação para estagiários. Sem possibilidade de adicionar dependentes.
  • Plano Odontológico (Mais DOC) sem custos de coparticipação para os estagiários. Sem possibilidade de adicionar dependentes.
  • TotalPass e Wellhub (opcionais) o estagiário pode escolher a plataforma que melhor atender às suas necessidades. Ambas oferecem acesso a academias de diversas modalidades, esportes variados e aplicativos de saúde física, mental e financeira.
  • Seguro de Vida é uma proteção financeira para o estagiário e seus beneficiários em momentos de adversidade.
  • SESC oferece acesso a atividades culturais, esportivas, de lazer, saúde e educação, incentivando um estilo de vida saudável e equilibrado.
  • Open English oferece acesso a cursos de inglês ou espanhol em diversos formatos, com descontos exclusivos para estagiários e familiares.

Nossa Cultura

Na LiveMode, nossa missão é Transformar e Crescer o Esporte , e nossos valores são o combustível que nos move no dia a dia. Acreditamos que crescer exige inconformismo, ambição e consistência. Nossa cultura nasce disso: de gente que não aceita o que está aí, que quer fazer mais, aprender mais e entregar mais — sempre com responsabilidade e visão de futuro. Quem está na LiveMode está aqui para marcar a história do esporte no Brasil e no Mundo.

SOMOS EMPREENDEDORES

ontem, hoje e sempre. Escolhemos o gol e corremos atrás dele com tudo. Focamos em poucas prioridades e vamos até o fim, sem distrações. Tratamos cada recurso como se fosse nosso, decidindo rápido e com coragem. Comunicação? Direta, aberta e na velocidade do jogo.

SOMOS UM TIME DE ALTA PERFORMANCE

não uma família ou uma confraria de amigos. Família a gente não escolhe, mas o time escolhe quem joga. E quando o jogo é grande, não dá pra carregar quem não tá entregando. Aqui, a gente decide pelo que é melhor pra empresa, não pra uma área ou pessoa. Toda entrega tem um dono claro, que vai até o fim. Processos ajudam, mas não mandam: quem resolve são as pessoas.

SOMOS AMBICIOSOS

pensamos sempre grande. A gente já fez muita coisa grande. Mas quem está na LiveMode sabe que dá pra ir além. Porque quem é ambicioso de verdade vive com a sensação de que sempre dá pra melhorar, crescer, fazer mais impacto. Aqui, a ambição não é discurso. É prática. E é ela que nos leva a quebrar recorde atrás de recorde.

O QUE NOS MOVE É O FUTURO

Na LiveMode, o futuro já está em movimento — e quem não acompanha, fica pra trás. Por isso, tratamos tecnologia com urgência: testamos, aprendemos e aplicamos com velocidade. Queremos ser uma empresa IA first, porque acreditamos que dominar essas ferramentas não é opcional — é o que vai nos ajudar a alcançar nossa missão mais rápido. IA não é extra. É parte central do nosso dia a dia.

Nossa jornada começou em novembro de 2011, fruto da união entre Raia e Drogasil, crescendo até se tornar a maior rede de farmácias do Brasil e expandindo para além do varejo farmacêutico, integrando soluções B2B e plataformas digitais.

Com mais de um milhão de vidas atendidas diariamente em todo o país, cuidar de perto dos(as) nossos(as) clientes e das nossas pessoas está em nosso DNA. Somos mais de 57 mil profissionais comprometidos em construir o futuro da saúde com calor humano e tecnologia. Temos a sustentabilidade no centro da nossa estratégia, dividindo nossa ambição em três pilares: pessoas, negócio e planeta mais saudáveis.

title: Terapeuta Ocupacional - Duque de Caxias, RJ
description:
Visão Geral

Transformar vidas com saúde é o que nos move! Atuamos em todo o Brasil por meio de duas unidades de negócios, Amil e Rede Total Care, com mais de 1.500 hospitais credenciados e uma rede própria de hospitais, clínicas, centros de tratamento, home care e transporte médico. Com uma missão clara e valores sólidos, fortalecemos nossa cultura com compromisso de servir sempre melhor. Cuidamos das nossas pessoas colaboradoras para que esse cuidado se reflita na população que atendemos. Promovemos uma cultura inovadora, diversa, equitativa e inclusiva. Todas as candidaturas qualificadas são bem-vindas, sem distinção de etnia, raça, deficiência, orientação sexual, identidade ou expressão de gênero, idade, nacionalidade, religião ou qualquer outro marcador social. Reforçamos Que Não Solicitamos Pagamentos, Taxas Ou Códigos SMS Em Nossos Processos Seletivos. Todas As Oportunidades Estão Disponíveis Em Nossos Canais Oficiais e No Nosso Site De Carreira. Qualquer Situação Diferente Deve Ser Denunciada.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Realizar avaliação nos aspectos sensório-motores e cognitivos a fim de identificar limitações na funcionalidade e desempenho ocupacional nas atividades de auto cuidado, instrumentais da vida diária e de vida prática registrando os dados no formulário "Avaliação de Terapia Ocupacional" que deve ser impressa, assinada e constar nº do registro profissional;
  • Estabelecer objetivos do tratamento terapêutico ocupacional e data de reavaliação a fim de verificar se os objetivos propostos inicialmente foram alcançados e estabelecer a frequência dos atendimentos;
  • Consultar os registros do prontuário, pelo menos das últimas 24 horas antes de iniciar o atendimento do paciente, para compreender melhor o caso e assim ter condições de prestar uma assistência mais adequada;
  • Registrar no prontuário a evolução, após o atendimento do paciente, a fim de documentar a avaliação diária, conduta realizada, resposta do paciente à terapia, alterações de objetivos do tratamento e programação de novas condutas (se necessário), discussões com a equipe multidisciplinar e orientações fornecidas aos pacientes e seus familiares. A qualidade do registro em prontuário irá contribuir para garantir o acesso às informações do paciente e a continuidade do cuidado;
  • Indicar e orientar o uso de equipamento adaptativo e / ou tecnologia assistiva, a fim de facilitar o ganho funcional do paciente, incremento da independência e ganho de qualidade de vida;
  • Orientar e indicar adaptação de órtese bem como mudanças do estilo de vida, com orientação para manejo do tempo e conservação de energia;
  • Verificar a necessidade e escolher apropriadamente os recursos terapêuticos que serão utilizados para o atendimento ao paciente, preferencialmente antes do iniciar o atendimento, com intuito de antecipar as demandas visando prestar uma assistência completa;
  • Monitorar constantemente todos os pacientes em acompanhamento da terapia ocupacional observando a evolução clínica e necessidade de intervenções, a fim de planejar melhor a assistência ao paciente;
  • Orientar pacientes e familiares quanto ao tratamento proposto e seus objetivos durante a internação e na alta, com consequente, orientação domiciliar;
  • Preencher a estatística de pacientes atendidos diariamente com objetivo de controle do número atendimentos realizados;
  • Conversar com familiares, pelo menos uma vez ao dia, a fim de explicar os objetivos do acompanhamento da terapia ocupacional e dar oportunidade para esclarecimento de dúvidas;
  • Seguir normas e rotinas estabelecidas pelo SCIH (Serviço de Controle de Infecções Hospitalar), consultando os documentos disponíveis no sistema GED (Gerenciador de Documentos) e participando dos treinamentos, com o intuito de aplicar as ações e contribuir para a prevenção de infecções hospitalares;
  • Prestar assistência nas unidades de internação quando houver necessidade da Instituição (por exemplo, diminuição do nº de pacientes que precisam da assistência de fisioterapia na UTI);
  • Consultar e-mail corporativo diariamente;
  • Informar a supervisão a respeito de queixas de pacientes/familiares ou problemas gerais;
  • Executar atividades relacionadas aos processos da área, conforme designado pelos líderes imediatos ou de acordo com a necessidade da área;
  • Cumprir e respeitar as normas e regras instituídas pela empresa, bem como as regras dos órgãos certificadores adotados por esta instituição.

Qualificações Necessárias

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Terapia Ocupacional;
  • Conselho de Classe e Anuidade 2025 em dia;
  • Vivência anterior de pelo menos 1 ano em ambiente hospitalar ou ambulatorial, de acordo com o setor de trabalho;
  • Conhecimento intermediário do idioma Inglês;
  • Pacote Office: Word, Excel, Power Point, Outlook, básico ou intermediário;
  • Cursos de aprimoramento ou atualização nas áreas assistenciais;
  • Desejável curso de Suporte Básico de Vida (BLS) ou similar;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar de Segunda à Sexta de 8 às 14 na região de Duque de Caxias.

Palavras-Chave: Grupo Amil, Terapia Ocupacional, Terapeuta, Ambulatorial, Hospitalar, PCD, Pessoas com Deficiência, Duque de Caxias, Rio de Janeiro, RJ.

title: Senior Reservoir Engineer
description:
Overview

Galp has been part of society for generations, and as energy changes, we adapt too. Here you will have the opportunity to grow, with the resources you need to develop at your own pace, in your own way. Together we can continue to contribute to the communities where we live and work. We can build a more efficient future for ourselves and for future generations. We're counting on your energy ⚡

Bring your curiosity and passion into action. Join Galp today

About your future Team

You\'ll be joining Reservoir Engineering Team, sharing their mission to deliver decision-ready, high-quality reservoir engineering analyses that directly influence asset development, reserves maturation, and production optimization, while acting as a technical reference within the RE team and across upstream disciplines.

How will your day-to-day look like

  • Compressively and independently manage reservoir engineering discipline scopes across multiple assets, with business focus;
  • Own and deliver reservoir engineering studies for assigned assets across the asset life cycle;
  • Build, maintain, and quality-control dynamic reservoir models and associated forecasts;
  • Provide clear, structured, and decision-oriented recommendations to Asset Teams and management;
  • Act as technical authority for reservoir engineering studies within assigned assets;
  • Ensure technical consistency, robustness, and full traceability of assumptions, methodologies, and results;
  • Proactively identify value opportunities (production acceleration, recovery improvement, risk reduction);
  • Support mentoring and technical development of junior reservoir engineers;
  • Support new business opportunities screening, review, and technical assurance;
  • Act as a key integration pivot of critical decision making disciplines and scopes;
  • Lead and/or support R&D initiatives.

What makes you unique

  • Advanced dynamic simulation capability (history matching and forecasting) using Eclipse and Intersect;
  • Proven experience influencing well testing, well completion, development concepts, well phasing, and production strategies;
  • Reservoir engineering studies execution, including integration of well test data into forecasts and simulations;
  • Reserves and Resources classification expertise;
  • Uncertainty framing and scenario-based decision support;
  • Ability to translate complex technical work into clear business implications;
  • Strong cross-disciplinary integration (geology, petrophysics, production, facilities);
  • Structured problem solving and analytical rigour;
  • Proactive, independent and integrative mindset;

Benefits

  • An energy company integrated in the energy sector where you can make a difference;
  • Competitive salary and bonus;
  • Health insurance for you and your family;

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Galp, we have the ambition to be a Human Centered Company, and for that we acknowledge our responsibility to promote Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DEI) by having a genuine mindset, lived on our day-to-day, in all our processes. We believe that everyone should be celebrated and valued for who they are: not only for their potential, but also for their distinctive characteristics.

Jeito DaVita

O Jeito de Ser DaVita significa que nós dedicamos nossas Mentes, Corações e Mãos para atingir a Missão, vivenciar os Valores e construir uma Aldeia saudável. Cuidamos uns dos outros com a mesma intensidade com que cuidamos dos nossos pacientes.

  • Supervisionar o processo de faturamento, orientando a equipe distribuindo as atividades, acompanhando o desenvolvimento dos trabalhos e avaliando os resultados, prestando esclarecimentos aos clientes, convênios e prestadores sobre as dúvidas existentes, a fim de assegurar a eficiência do faturamento para a instituição;
  • Liderar a equipe de colaboradores de faturamento, acompanhando e orientando processos de faturamento eficientes, assim como garantir que as faturas sejam emitidas de maneira oportuna e precisa;
  • Supervisionar o ciclo de faturamento, desde a inserção de dados em sistema, geração de faturas até a entrega aos clientes, parceiros, convênios entre outros, incluindo a verificação de informações precisas;
  • Garantir que todas as faturas estejam em conformidade com as regulamentações fiscais e financeiras locais e nacionais, assim como acompanhar a compatibilidade dos lançamentos do pré-faturamento com os dados do prontuário;
  • Monitorar o processo de validação e realizar a análise dos dados de cobrança enviados por credenciados da organização e encaminhar a área de contas a pagar, bem como, transmitir o faturamento mensal às contas médicas e contabilidade, quando necessário;
  • Orientar e conferir o cálculo, análise e efetivação dos honorários médicos, e acompanhar com o prestador médico o recebimento dos relatórios gerenciais;
  • Monitorar o recebimento, conferência e o encaminhamento das notas fiscais para o setor de contas a pagar, bem como garantir a inserção dos dados no sistema;
  • Receber o movimento bancário, atualizando as informações sobre os recebimentos, bem como controlar valores recebidos versus o planejado nas análises de faturamento;
  • Prestar orientação técnica a equipe quanto às atividades de faturamento, fechamento e repasse médico, bem como promover a apuração junto às áreas de apoio de valores a serem deduzidos dos honorários dos prestadores de serviços médicos;
  • Abordar e resolver problemas relacionados a faturamento, como disputas de faturas, erros de faturamento e problemas de cobrança;
  • Preparar relatórios regulares sobre o desempenho do departamento de faturamento, incluindo métricas-chave e indicadores de desempenho;
  • Buscar o atingimento das metas da área, através do acompanhamento dos resultados, e cumprimento dos planos de ações para correções e revisões para melhorias nos processos e resultados;
  • Identificar oportunidades de otimização e automação de processos de faturamento para aumentar a eficiência;
  • Acompanhar e orientar a manutenção de registros, sua organização e arquivamento dos documentos relacionados ao faturamento de acordo com as políticas da empresa;
  • Contribuir na preparação dos relatórios gerenciais, visando assegurar a disponibilidade de informações financeiras e sobre andamento dos trabalhos e resultados alcançados, objetivando o suporte adequado ao processo decisório para análise e tomada de decisão;
  • Disseminar à missão, visão, valores e a filosofia de trabalho da empresa, mediante a comunicação e engajamento dos líderes e equipes, enaltecendo questões relacionadas à disciplina, respeito à hierarquia, ética e profissionalismo, assegurando alinhamento das pessoas às diretrizes vigentes;
  • Contribuir na elaboração do planejamento estratégico e o cumprimento do programa orçamentário de custeio de sua área, bem como a consistência e confiabilidade das informações gerenciais prestadas pela área, mediante adequada orientação, direção e suporte quando da confecção dos relatórios gerenciais, bem como acompanhamento e controle dos dispêndios havidos e oportuna recomendação quanto à forma de correção dos desvios;
  • Manter a qualificação e desempenho da equipe de trabalho, identificando necessidades de capacitação e desenvolvimento, promoção, transferência, contratação/reposição, etc., bem como promoção da gestão do desempenho e o feedback, interagindo junto a equipe na aplicação das políticas, buscando um ambiente motivador para seus colaboradores;

  • Desenvolver outras atividades inerentes ao cargo ou a critério de seu superior imediato, desde que habilitado e estejam de acordo com o seu conhecimento e experiência.

Nossa cultura é centrada no cliente, e buscamos constantemente soluções para aprimorar sua experiência. Estamos construindo a cada dia uma cultura com base no respeito e valorização das diferenças, encorajando as pessoas a serem quem elas são, independente de gênero, etnia, raça, orientação sexual, religião ou deficiência. title: Football Operations Specialist
description:
By bringing together next-gen technology and the finest live data available, Genius Sports is enabling a new era of sports for fans worldwide, delivering experiences that are more immersive, interactive and personalised than ever before. Learn more at geniussports.com.

The Role

Football Operations Specialists are critical to the successful delivery of Genius Sports’ officiating and officiating technology services. Operating in live match environments, you will work closely with qualified match officials and Genius Sports leadership to ensure flawless execution before, during, and after each fixture.

You will be trusted to perform under pressure, apply expert knowledge of football and technology, and uphold the highest operational standards in a competition followed by millions worldwide.

This is a part-time contract position where we anticipate the engagement will be for an initial 2 year. You will be paid on a per-match fee basis, with additional paid training hours.

Matchday Operations

  • Operate football officiating technology systems during live Brasileirão fixtures.
  • Work directly alongside match officials, supporting decision-making through accurate, timely, and clear technical execution.
  • Identify, retrieve, and present the best possible camera angles and operational outputs in real time.
  • Maintain constant situational awareness during live play, where timing and precision are critical.

Pre-Match Preparation

  • Plan and manage all pre-match operational activities, typically beginning up to three hours before kick-off.
  • Conduct comprehensive system, hardware, and software checks to ensure full readiness.
  • Verify calibration, configuration, and operational integrity in line with Genius Sports SOPs.

Performance Monitoring & Issue Escalation

  • Monitor system performance throughout the match, proactively identifying anomalies or risks.
  • Independently troubleshoot technical issues in high-pressure environments.
  • Escalate issues clearly and professionally to senior operational leadership when required.

Post-Match Duties

  • Complete detailed post-match reports aligned with Genius Sports and CBF requirements.
  • Clip and document relevant match situations to support quality assurance, learning, and continuous improvement.
  • Contribute to operational feedback loops to enhance future performance.

Operational Excellence & Development

  • Apply and uphold Standard Operating Procedures consistently across all assignments.
  • Contribute to training sessions and scenario-based simulations as part of ongoing development.
  • Support the development of best practices as the partnership with CBF evolves.

What You\'ll Bring Language Skills: Portuguese and English required

  • Strong Football Knowledge: Excellent understanding of football, match dynamics, and the Laws of the Game. Prior exposure to officiating environments is highly advantageous.
  • Composure Under Pressure: Proven ability to perform in live match environments where decisions are time-critical and highly scrutinised.
  • Technical Proficiency: Confident working with technology systems, with the ability to diagnose and resolve issues independently.
  • Attention to Detail: Meticulous approach to preparation, execution, and reporting.
  • Clear Communication: Professional, calm, and precise communication style, particularly under pressure.
  • Self-Motivated & Accountable: Comfortable working independently as a contractor while representing Genius Sports and CBF to the highest standard.
  • Flexibility: Willingness to work evenings, weekends, and irregular hours aligned to the Brasileirão match calendar, including travel as required.

Contract & Working Model

  • This is a contractor role, paid on a per-match fee basis, with additional paid training hours.
  • Assignments will be scheduled according to competition needs and operational readiness.
  • Contractors will be expected to meet defined performance and availability standards throughout the season.

We enjoy an ‘office-first’ culture and maximize opportunities to collaborate, connect and learn together. Our hybrid working models differ depending on your role and location.

As well as a competitive salary and range of benefits, we’re committed to supporting employee wellbeing and helping you grow your skills, experience and career. Learn more about how rewarding life at Genius can be at Reward | Genius Sports.

One team, being brave, driving change

title: Senior Regulatory Analyst
description:
Overview

The Senior Regulatory Analyst will be responsible for ensuring regulatory compliance for offshore operations and projects, defining deliverable scopes and deadlines, and supporting engineering, sustainability, safety, project management, and operations teams. This position will coordinate regulatory requirements, consolidate technical documentation, assess compliance risks, support audits and inspections, and implement action plans to address findings. The role contributes directly to maintaining operational licenses, preventing non‑compliance, avoiding fines or interdictions and ensuring alignment with internal schedules, budgets and applicable Brazilian authorities’ requirements.

Responsibilities

  • Define the scope and deadlines for deliverables that sustain compliance with applicable regulatory requirements, observing production schedules and budgets.
  • Support the definition of responsibilities and resources to achieve regulatory compliance efficiently, observing the BWE organization charts and budgets.
  • Incorporate lessons learned to BWE, set action plans to prevent or address audit findings, notifications, and conditions to operate imposed by the Authorities.
  • Collaborate with engineering, sustainability, safety, project management, and operations to ensure awareness of regulatory requirements, build compliance, and fulfill BWE schedules.
  • Ensure that compliance-related tasks are executed efficiently, facilitating licenses and approvals, as well as preventing fines and interdictions.
  • Consolidate engineering document lists, including all tech safety studies that are required to grant and sustain licenses and approvals needed to operate.
  • Assess the content of engineering, tech safety, and other management system documents to provide proper support and guidance to achieve compliance.
  • Follow up on specific discussions and execution wherever assigned to ensure proper incorporation of regulatory compliance requirements and related risk.
  • Support activities to implement BWE strategy and scope for internal regulatory compliance self-assessment, inspections, and audits to prevent project schedule delays, interdictions and fines.
  • Track, manage, and ensure proper closure and documentation of regulatory-related action items.
  • Perform and/or guide inspections and audits of BWE facilities to assess and ensure proper compliance with regulatory and statutory requirements.
  • Organize and coordinate internal preparations for regulatory audits.
  • Flag to the Regulatory and Institutional Affairs Manager always when a potential critical non-conformance is identified or delays in regulatory compliance may delay schedules or not follow the original budgets.
  • Support all other regulatory-related activities when required.

Education

  • Engineering degree.

Experience

  • Experience with regulatory requirements applied to offshore platforms.
  • Experience fulfilling requirements for ANP shipyard audits.
  • Experience responding to ANP conditions to operate.
  • Knowledge of Class, Flag, and Navy requirements.

Knowledge

  • Good understanding and knowledge of Offshore systems
  • Familiar with engineering/industry standards such as API, ASME, ASTM, NACE etc
  • Advanced English.

title: Lead Gas Master Planning Specialist - Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package
description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat relocation package.

Job Overview

We are seeking a Gas Master Planning Specialist to join our Gas Operations Technical Support Division (GOTSD) under Gas Operations Technical Support & Planning Department (GOTS&PD)

GOTSD is responsible for the strategic growth and optimization of the gas business, integrating technical expertise, and digital and technologies innovation. ITMG also oversees the Master Gas Network planning, while optimizing the gas supply portfolio through advanced modeling and cost-benefit frameworks. It focuses on deploying cutting-edge technologies—such as AI, IoT, and digital twins to deliver high-impact solutions to shape the future of gas operations

Your Primary role is to help translating corporate strategies into comprehensive development plans, which typically span 10 to 20 years and are used to guide capital investment decisions.

Duties and Responsibilities

As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  • Assess existing facilities and infrastructure performance.
  • Forecast future demand and supply scenarios, including shifts in market dynamics, population demographics, or regulatory changes.
  • Evaluate the impact of emerging technologies and sustainability practices.
  • Develop conceptual designs and scopes for new projects or upgrades.
  • Work on facilities planning which often leads Business Master Plans and supports Facility Master Plans.
  • Ensure that all relevant data and perspectives are integrated into the plan and aligned with priorities and resource allocation.
  • Perform cost-benefit analyses.
  • Compare alternative solutions to determine the most efficient and sustainable path forward.
  • Present data-driven recommendations to support decision-making at critical milestones.
  • Schedule regular updates (typically every 3–5 years depending on the plan type).
  • Revise plans in response to major changes in assumptions, such as new market conditions, regulatory shifts, or technological advancements.
  • Ensure the plans remain relevant and actionable over time.
  • As the successful candidate you will hold a Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, preferably Mechanical or Chemical. An advanced degree in Engineering, Business, or Project Management is a plus.
  • You will have minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in the oil & gas industry or energy sector, with a strong understanding of upstream operations.
  • Certification in Project Management (PMP) is preferred.
  • You will have experience in developing or reviewing Master Plans for Gas industrial or infrastructure projects.
  • You will be familiar with capital planning processes, feasibility studies, and economic modeling.
  • You will have experience in working with multi-disciplinary teams and interfacing with senior management and executive stakeholders.
  • You must have a strategic thinking and long-term planning mindset as well as analytical and problem-solving skills
  • You will have project management capabilities, including scheduling, resource coordination, and milestone tracking.
  • You will have skills in planning and modeling tools (e.g., Excel, Primavera, SAP, or other enterprise planning systems)
  • You will be able to synthesize complex technical and commercial data into clear actionable plans is necessary.
  • You will be able to successfully endorse and implement capital projects based on Master Plan recommendations.

Working environment

Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.

At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world’s biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.

We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.

Aramco energizes the world economy.

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.

With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations’ spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.
